advisories.title: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion on nested brace groups causing stack exhaustion
advisories.reason: Not shipped. brace-expansion 5.0.9 reaches this repository only through the devDependency @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 1.0.0 (the Pi host we typecheck and test against), whose npm-shrinkwrap pins minimatch 10.2.6 -> brace-expansion 5.0.9, so it cannot be re-resolved from our lockfile. The plugin's own runtime dependencies (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, minisearch) do not include it: npm audit --omit=dev is clean (assessed 2026-10-08). Customers run their own Pi host, and pi-coding-agent 1.1.0 depends on brace-expansion 5.0.12. The patterns reaching this copy come only from our own test runs. Remove when the development host baseline moves to pi-coding-agent 1.1.0 or later (item dde31281).

The sibling moderate advisory GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr on the same copy does not block. Remove with the host baseline move (item dde31281).
